findings.subject: PPSW1 cross-session attempt commit
findings.mechanism: Attempt carries only generation. Distinct sessions start at generation 0; Session A accepts an Attempt computed by Session B. A physical state is replaced while its work counters show no producing callback/linear solve.
findings.observed: foreign_attempt_accepted=true; A y becomes 1.9999999999999716 from 1; A rhs=0 and linear_solves=0
findings.minimum_fix: Bind Attempt to an unforgeable session identity plus generation; validate identity before any mutation. Test same-generation foreign accept and reject.

findings.subject: PPSW1 invalid time/state acceptance
findings.mechanism: Session::new validates Config but not State. advance_capped validates step ratio but not State.t or representable forward progress. start validates finite t_init and positive h0 separately but not its resulting endpoint.
findings.observed: NaN time accepted by Session::new and try_step. t=1e16,h=.01 accepted without progress; starter likewise reports identical endpoint after 11 RHS calls.
findings.minimum_fix: Validate all six y/f dimensions and finiteness, finite time and positive history step at session construction; require finite strictly increasing representable endpoint before callbacks/allocation for advance/start. Retain incurred work on numerical failures.

findings.subject: PPSW1 serial stage RHS despite independent stage data
findings.mechanism: Six stage linear solves use ParallelExecution::map_ordered; subsequent six independent eval_rhs calls run in a serial loop. RHS assembly also remains serial.
findings.minimum_fix: Use bounded ordered parallel per-row evaluation with explicit replay/thread-safety assumptions and exact attempted-work accounting. Verify bitwise serial/parallel state and callback failure ledger. Benchmark cost sufficiently above task overhead; do not claim an 8x RODAS speedup.

findings.subject: Whole-IVP stiff accuracy and performance qualification remains open
findings.mechanism: Passing formal order, synthetic trajectory and contract tests does not establish strong-stiff order, matched achieved-error speed, step count, fallback fraction or new release reliability. T01 also retained cases exceeding global-error budget and incomplete reference authority.
findings.minimum_fix: Execute T02 variable-ratio/nonnormal/short-span/startup/estimator qualification using frozen T01 common-grid oracle; calibrate before blind holdout. Charge startup, rejected, speculative and fallback work.

findings.subject: Current Peer-W path does not satisfy full derivative/matrix/Newton-free mission
findings.mechanism: solve_stages materializes dense J and factors dense common W. JVP-only fallback reconstructs J by basis columns. Startup factors a 5n-by-5n matrix and performs Newton. Per-step solves are linear and six-way independent.
findings.minimum_fix: Implement an opt-in common-W operator + independent/block Krylov path with original-residual checks and a separately qualified starter; label supplied JVP as derivative-based. RHS-only new methods require their own consistency/stability proof.

findings.subject: Frontend unification exists partially; full portfolio not integrated
findings.mechanism: vigilode already offers Problem/Options/Rodas5p, GeneralOde and ProductionSolver. ProductionSolver supports RHS-only explicit or selective supplied-JVP switching for smooth forward identity-mass endpoint IVPs. Peer-W and geometry-specific kernels remain separate; terminal events on legacy facade are postprocessed.
findings.minimum_fix: Reuse existing public types and capability queries. Add method descriptors and adapters incrementally; preserve refusal semantics, partial states, error/work authority and permission-safe fallback. Do not introduce a competing frontend or silently enable unqualified kernels.
